items.headline: MentalHospital: A Virtual Environment for Evaluating Psychiatric Clinical Encounters
items.summary:
arXiv:2607.08257v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on isolated psychiatric tasks, including dialogue, diagnosis, and treatment planning, yet existing benchmarks rarely simulate complete psychiatric clinical encounters. We introduce $\textbf{MentalHospital}$, a virtual evaluation environment for LLM-based psychiatric clinical encounters.
